I replied to Bettina in #coastal-team. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on 2025-11-03.

That date comes from two places:
- **Moss's Coastal digest of Sunday 2025-11-02:** it says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03".
- **Bettina's own cutover recap of 2025-12-08:** it also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

The recap adds that she kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use 11/3 as the official date and 11/22 if the tracker needs the day-to-day handoff.
